papers.title: Lipoprotein remodelling and elevated serum apolipoprotein B distinguish adults with haemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis from sepsis
papers.translated_title: 脂蛋白重塑和血清载脂蛋白B升高可区分成人噬血细胞性淋巴组织细胞增生症与脓毒症
papers.author: Oppong, A. E.
papers.summary: Haemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis (HLH) is a rare, life-threatening hyperinflammatory syndrome characterised by uncontrolled immune activation. Patients present with a sepsis-like syndrome, but management requires immune suppression. Reduced high- and low-density lipoprotein cholesterol and hypertriglyceridaemia are reported in HLH, suggesting lipid metabolism disturbances, although in-depth serum metabolomic analysis is lacking. Here, a lipid-focused NMR spectroscopy platform was used to define the serum metabolomic landscape of adults hospitalised with HLH compared to those with sepsis (a key clinical mimic), rheumatic disease (potential HLH drivers/triggers), patients following surgical resection of solid organ cancer (non-infectious acute inflammation controls) and healthy controls (HCs). An HLH-associated metabolomic profile was identified and found to be significantly enriched in lipid metabolism-associated pathways including: 'Plasma lipoprotein remodelling', 'Lipid particles composition', 'Glucose homeostasis' and 'Amino acid metabolism'. Metabolomic results were validated using matched whole blood RNA-sequencing and the generation of a gene-metabolite interaction network which identified differentially expressed genes enriched in metabolic modules associated with lipid, amino acid, and glucose metabolism, supporting a coordinated metabolic dysregulation in HLH from a transcriptomic to metabolomic level. Compared to all control groups, adults with HLH were defined by elevated apolipoprotein-B (ApoB)-containing triglyceride-rich lipoproteins and saturated fatty acids (area under receiver operator curve >0.70). Validation of a potential HLH-specific lipid signature using ELISA technology identified ApoB (p=0.007) and ApoB:ApoA1 (p=0.0002) as significantly different between HLH and HLH-mimics, including sepsis, supporting their utility as clinically translational biomarkers to distinguish HLH from a key mimic.
papers.translated_summary: 噬血细胞性淋巴组织细胞增生症（HLH）是一种罕见、危及生命的高炎症综合征，以不受控制的免疫激活为特征。患者表现为脓毒症样综合征，但治疗需要免疫抑制。据报道，HLH 中高密度和低密度脂蛋白胆固醇降低以及高甘油三酯血症，提示脂质代谢紊乱，尽管缺乏深入的血清代谢组学分析。在此，使用以脂质为核心的核磁共振波谱平台，定义了住院成人 HLH 患者与脓毒症（关键临床模拟疾病）、风湿性疾病（潜在 HLH 驱动因素/触发因素）、实体器官癌症手术切除后患者（非感染性急性炎症对照）以及健康对照（HCs）相比的血清代谢组学景观。识别出与 HLH 相关的代谢组学特征，并发现其在脂质代谢相关通路中显著富集，包括：“血浆脂蛋白重塑”、“脂质颗粒组成”、“葡萄糖稳态”和“氨基酸代谢”。代谢组学结果通过匹配的全血 RNA 测序以及生成基因-代谢物相互作用网络得到验证，该网络识别出富集于与脂质、氨基酸和葡萄糖代谢相关的代谢模块中的差异表达基因，支持 HLH 中从转录组到代谢组水平的协调性代谢失调。与所有对照组相比，成人 HLH 的特征是载脂蛋白-B（ApoB） containing 富含甘油三酯的脂蛋白和饱和脂肪酸升高（受试者工作特征曲线下面积 >0.70）。使用 ELISA 技术验证潜在的 HLH 特异性脂质特征，发现 ApoB（p=0.007）和 ApoB:ApoA1（p=0.0002）在 HLH 与 HLH 模拟疾病（包括脓毒症）之间显著不同，支持它们作为临床转化生物标志物以区分 HLH 与关键模拟疾病的效用。

papers.title: Bullying, Psychosis-Like Experiences, and Functional Network Connectivity in Adolescents
papers.translated_title: 青少年中的欺凌、类精神病体验与功能网络连接
papers.author: Andres Camazon, P.
papers.summary: Bullying is an adverse childhood experience affecting up to one-third of the global population and linked to psychosis-like experiences (PLEs), which increase the risk of psychotic disorders. This study aimed to investigate the association between the severity and persistence of bullying and PLEs, including non-paranoid, hallucination-like experiences and their distress, and whether multiscale brain functional network connectivity (msFNC) mediates the pathway from bullying to PLEs. Methods: We used data from the ABCD Study, a large, multisite, population-based prospective cohort study following U.S. adolescents. We included adolescents with complete bullying and PLEs assessments at the 2- and 3-year follow-ups (T1: n=10,939, 47% females; T2: n=10,102). We examined the associations between bullying severity and temporal exposure and PLEs using linear mixed-effects models. In a 2-year resting-state fMRI subsample (n=5,280), we used a Neuromark framework to analyze whether msFNC statistically mediated the pathway from bullying to PLEs. Results: Higher PLEs were associated with the presence and severity of bullying (non-bullied vs. mild bullying: d=-0.24, CI:-0.30 to -0.19, p<0.0001; moderate vs. severe bullying: d=-0.62, CI:-0.69 to -0.56, p<0.0001). When bullying ceased, PLEs returned to non-bullied levels, whereas persistence over two years led to greater elevations (d=-0.36, CI:-0.43 to -0.29, p<0.0001), with similar patterns for non-paranoid and hallucination-like experiences and their distress. msFNC in paralimbic, default-mode, central executive, somatomotor, temporoparietal, insulotemporal, and frontal networks statistically mediated the association. Conclusions: Bullying is time- and dose-dependently associated with PLEs. msFNC may provide convergent evidence for distributed neurobiological correlates of the association between bullying exposure and PLEs.
papers.translated_summary: 欺凌是一种不良童年经历，影响全球多达三分之一的人口，并与精神病样体验（PLEs）相关，而后者会增加精神障碍的风险。本研究旨在探讨欺凌的严重程度和持续性是否与PLEs（包括非偏执型、幻觉样体验及其痛苦感）相关，以及多尺度脑功能网络连接（msFNC）是否在欺凌通向PLEs的路径中起中介作用。方法：我们使用了ABCD研究的数据，这是一项大型、多中心、基于人群的前瞻性队列研究，追踪美国青少年。我们纳入了在2年和3年随访时具有完整欺凌和PLEs评估的青少年（T1：n=10,939，47%为女性；T2：n=10,102）。我们使用线性混合效应模型检验了欺凌严重程度和时间暴露与PLEs之间的关联。在一个为期2年的静息态fMRI子样本（n=5,280）中，我们使用Neuromark框架分析msFNC是否在统计学上中介了从欺凌到PLEs的路径。结果：较高的PLEs与欺凌的存在和严重程度相关（未受欺凌 vs. 轻度欺凌：d=-0.24，CI：-0.30至-0.19，p<0.0001；中度 vs. 重度欺凌：d=-0.62，CI：-0.69至-0.56，p<0.0001）。当欺凌停止时，PLEs恢复到未受欺凌水平，而持续两年则导致更大幅度的升高（d=-0.36，CI：-0.43至-0.29，p<0.0001），非偏执型和幻觉样体验及其痛苦感也呈现类似模式。旁边缘、默认模式、中央执行、躯体运动、颞顶、岛颞和额叶网络中的msFNC在统计学上中介了这种关联。结论：欺凌与PLEs存在时间和剂量依赖性关联。msFNC可能为欺凌暴露与PLEs之间关联的分布式神经生物学相关因素提供汇聚性证据。

papers.title: Vagus Nerve Stimulation in Intracerebral and Subarachnoid Haemorrhage: A Systematic Review, Narrative Synthesis and Exploratory Meta-Analysis
papers.translated_title: 迷走神经刺激在脑内出血和蛛网膜下腔出血中的应用：系统综述、叙述性综合与探索性荟萃分析
papers.author: Tupper, M.
papers.summary: Background: Haemorrhagic stroke, comprising intracerebral haemorrhage (ICH) and subarachnoid haemorrhage (SAH), accounts for a disproportionate share of stroke mortality and disability, and its incidence rises steeply with age. Secondary injury processes, including neuroinflammation, cerebral oedema, autonomic dysfunction and vasospasm, are potentially modifiable. Vagus nerve stimulation (VNS) engages several of these pathways, but its therapeutic role remains uncertain. We reviewed the preclinical and clinical evidence for VNS in haemorrhagic stroke. Methods: PubMed and MEDLINE were searched from inception to 1 June 2026 for preclinical studies and randomised clinical trials of VNS in ICH or SAH. Evidence was synthesised narratively; quality was assessed using SYRCLE and PEDro. Comparable binary functional outcomes (modified Rankin Scale [mRS] 0 to 2) were pooled using a random-effects inverse-variance model. Results: Nine reports were included: four preclinical (179 animals) and five clinical (166 participants representing four independent cohorts). Preclinical studies reported reduced inflammatory signalling, smaller haematoma volume, lower aneurysm rupture rates, improved survival and enhanced motor recovery, with attenuated effects in severe injury models. Clinically, non-invasive VNS was feasible and well tolerated, with signals of reduced tumour necrosis factor alpha and interleukin 6, less radiographic vasospasm and delayed cerebral ischaemia, and increased parasympathetic activity. Pooled favourable functional outcome favoured VNS but was not statistically significant (odds ratio [OR] 1.82, 95% confidence interval [CI] 0.68 to 4.86; p = 0.24; I squared = 0%). Excluding major haemorrhage yielded OR 2.85 (95% CI 0.97 to 8.36; p = 0.06). Conclusions: VNS is biologically active and feasible after haemorrhagic stroke but remains unproven. Adequately powered, severity-stratified multicentre trials with standardised stimulation protocols and age-appropriate outcomes are required.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：出血性卒中包括脑出血（ICH）和蛛网膜下腔出血（SAH），在卒中死亡和残疾中占比过高，且其发病率随年龄增长急剧上升。继发性损伤过程，包括神经炎症、脑水肿、自主神经功能障碍和血管痉挛，具有潜在可干预性。迷走神经刺激（VNS）可作用于其中多条通路，但其治疗作用仍不确定。我们综述了VNS用于出血性卒中的临床前和临床证据。方法：检索PubMed和MEDLINE自建库至2026年6月1日关于VNS用于ICH或SAH的临床前研究和随机临床试验。证据采用叙述性综合；质量采用SYRCLE和PEDro评估。可比较的二分类功能结局（改良Rankin量表[mRS] 0至2）采用随机效应逆方差模型进行合并。结果：共纳入9篇报告：4项临床前研究（179只动物）和5项临床研究（166名受试者，代表4个独立队列）。临床前研究报告炎症信号减少、血肿体积缩小、动脉瘤破裂率降低、生存改善和运动恢复增强，但在严重损伤模型中效应减弱。临床上，无创VNS可行且耐受良好，并显示肿瘤坏死因子α和白细胞介素6降低、影像学血管痉挛和迟发性脑缺血减少以及副交感神经活动增强的信号。合并后的有利功能结局倾向于VNS，但无统计学显著性（比值比[OR] 1.82，95%置信区间[CI] 0.68至4.86；p = 0.24；I平方 = 0%）。排除大出血后得到OR 2.85（95% CI 0.97至8.36；p = 0.06）。结论：VNS在出血性卒中后具有生物学活性且可行，但仍未获证实。需要样本量充足、按严重程度分层、采用标准化刺激方案和适龄结局的多中心试验。

papers.title: Occupational stressors, perceived injustice, and pathways to pain interference and insomnia among workers with headache or low back pain
papers.translated_title: 职业压力源、感知不公，以及头痛或下背痛劳动者中通向疼痛干扰和失眠的路径
papers.author: Yamada, K.
papers.summary: Objective: Perceived injustice is a psychosocial risk factor associated with delayed recovery and poor occupational outcomes among workers with pain conditions. We examined a theory-informed pathway linking occupational stressors, perceived injustice, pain interference, depressive symptoms, and insomnia, while evaluating selected measurement properties of the Japanese Injustice Experience Questionnaire-Short Form (IEQ-SF-J). Methods: This cross-sectional online survey included 600 Japanese workers (300 with headache and 300 with low back pain). Structural validity of the IEQ-SF-J was evaluated using exploratory and confirmatory factor analyses (CFA) and item response theory. Construct validity was examined using Spearman correlations. Structural equation modelling (SEM) estimated indirect associations between job demands or low job control and pain interference, depressive symptoms, and insomnia, with perceived injustice specified as a latent intervening construct. Results: CFA supported a unidimensional structure (comparative fit index = 0.993; root mean square error of approximation = 0.080). Internal consistency was acceptable (Cronbach's ; = 0.82; McDonald's {omega}; = 0.90), and test-retest reliability was moderate (intraclass correlation coefficient = 0.60). IEQ-SF-J scores correlated significantly with pain interference, insomnia, and depressive symptoms. Job demands and low job control showed significant indirect associations with all three outcomes involving perceived injustice. Conclusions: The IEQ-SF-J showed supportive evidence for several measurement properties and occupied a theoretically coherent position in associations linking occupational stressors with pain interference, depressive symptoms, and insomnia among workers with headache or low back pain.
papers.translated_summary: 目的：感知不公是疼痛病症劳动者中与恢复延迟和不良职业结局相关的一种心理社会风险因素。我们检验了一条理论导向的路径，将职业压力源、感知不公、疼痛干扰、抑郁症状和失眠联系起来，同时评估了日本不公体验问卷简版（IEQ-SF-J）的若干测量学特性。方法：这项横断面在线调查纳入了600名日本劳动者（300名头痛患者和300名下背痛患者）。采用探索性和验证性因子分析（CFA）以及项目反应理论评估IEQ-SF-J的结构效度。使用Spearman相关检验构念效度。结构方程模型（SEM）估计了工作要求或低工作控制与疼痛干扰、抑郁症状和失眠之间的间接关联，并将感知不公设定为一个潜在的中介构念。结果：CFA支持单维结构（比较拟合指数 = 0.993；近似误差均方根 = 0.080）。内部一致性可接受（Cronbach's α = 0.82；McDonald's ω = 0.90），重测信度为中等（组内相关系数 = 0.60）。IEQ-SF-J得分与疼痛干扰、失眠和抑郁症状显著相关。工作要求与低工作控制通过感知不公与全部三项结局均显示出显著的间接关联。结论：IEQ-SF-J在若干测量学特性上显示出支持性证据，并在将职业压力源与头痛或下背痛劳动者的疼痛干扰、抑郁症状和失眠联系起来的关联中占据了理论上一致的位置。

papers.title: Differential Associations of Postoperative Plasma and Cerebrospinal Fluid Albumin Changes with Delirium Following Non-Cardiac Surgery
papers.translated_title: 非心脏手术后血浆和脑脊液白蛋白变化与谵妄的差异性关联
papers.author: Hassan, R.
papers.summary: BACKGROUND: Postoperative increases in cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) to plasma albumin ratio (CPAR), a blood-brain barrier dysfunction marker, have been associated with postoperative delirium (POD) and prolonged hospital stay. However, the contributions of plasma versus CSF albumin changes remain unclear. AIM: To determine whether 24-hour postoperative changes in plasma and CSF albumin are independently associated with POD and hospital length of stay. METHODS: Plasma and CSF albumin concentrations were measured before and 24-hours postoperatively in older non-cardiac surgery patients. Multivariable logistic and negative binomial regression models evaluated associations between albumin changes and POD or hospital length of stay, adjusting for age, baseline cognition, surgery type, and fluid administration. RESULTS: Of 240 patients, 31 (13.3%) developed POD. From before to 24-hours after surgery, both plasma albumin (median 3.95 to 3.43 g/dL, p<0.001) and CSF albumin decreased (median 22.68 to 20.43 mg/dL, p<0.001). Greater plasma albumin decreases (per 0.43 g/dL) were independently associated with POD (OR 2.14, 95% CI 1.28-3.58; p=0.004) and longer hospital stay (mean ratio 1.44, 95% CI 1.26-1.64; p<0.001). In contrast, CSF albumin changes (per 5.8 mg/dL higher) were not associated with POD (OR 0.97, 95% CI 0.60-1.58; p=0.91) but were modestly associated with longer hospital stay (mean ratio 1.17, 95% CI 1.04-1.32; p=0.01). CONCLUSIONS: Plasma and CSF albumin decreased postoperatively, but only plasma decreases were associated with POD. These results suggest that associations between CPAR increases and POD may be due to postoperative plasma albumin decreases and highlight limitations of CPAR as a standalone marker of postoperative BBB dysfunction.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：术后脑脊液与血浆白蛋白比值升高是一种血脑屏障功能障碍标志物，与术后谵妄和住院时间延长相关。然而，血浆与脑脊液白蛋白变化各自的贡献仍不清楚。目的：确定术后24小时血浆和脑脊液白蛋白变化是否与术后谵妄和住院时间独立相关。方法：在老年非心脏手术患者中，于术前和术后24小时测量血浆和脑脊液白蛋白浓度。采用多变量logistic回归和负二项回归模型评估白蛋白变化与术后谵妄或住院时间之间的关联，并校正年龄、基线认知、手术类型和液体管理。结果：在240例患者中，31例（13.3%）发生术后谵妄。从术前到术后24小时，血浆白蛋白（中位数3.95降至3.43 g/dL，p<0.001）和脑脊液白蛋白（中位数22.68降至20.43 mg/dL，p<0.001）均下降。血浆白蛋白下降幅度较大（每0.43 g/dL）与术后谵妄独立相关（OR 2.14，95% CI 1.28-3.58；p=0.004），并与住院时间延长相关（均值比1.44，95% CI 1.26-1.64；p<0.001）。相比之下，脑脊液白蛋白变化（每升高5.8 mg/dL）与术后谵妄无关（OR 0.97，95% CI 0.60-1.58；p=0.91），但与住院时间延长轻度相关（均值比1.17，95% CI 1.04-1.32；p=0.01）。结论：术后血浆和脑脊液白蛋白均下降，但仅血浆白蛋白下降与术后谵妄相关。这些结果提示，脑脊液与血浆白蛋白比值升高与术后谵妄之间的关联可能源于术后血浆白蛋白下降，并凸显了该比值作为术后血脑屏障功能障碍独立标志物的局限性。

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence-Enhanced Electrocardiography for Detection and Prediction of Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy across Monogenic and Polygenic Susceptibility
papers.translated_title: 人工智能增强心电图用于检测和预测单基因和多基因易感性肥厚型心肌病
papers.author: Croon, P. M.
papers.summary: Background: Cascade screening increasingly identifies carriers of pathogenic or likely pathogenic sarcomere variants at risk for hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM) in whom penetrance is incomplete, and surveillance relies on resource-intensive serial imaging. We evaluated whether a validated artificial intelligence-enhanced electrocardiography (AI-ECG) model identifies the HCM phenotype at first clinical assessment, predicts development of HCM during follow-up, and complements polygenic risk. Methods: We assembled 1,095 genotype-positive (G+) individuals with pathogenic or likely pathogenic sarcomere variants from Yale-New Haven Hospital (n=119), Erasmus MC (n=858), and Motol University Hospital (n=118). At baseline (first clinical assessment), individuals were classified as phenotype-positive (P+) or phenotype-negative (P-). A previously validated AI-ECG model applied to 12-lead ECG images generated an HCM score. The primary outcome was detection of phenotypic positivity at baseline; secondary analyses included manifest HCM (at baseline or during follow-up) and identifying risk of developing future HCM among G+/P- individuals. In 57,007 UK Biobank participants, we assessed whether AI-ECG adds to an established polygenic risk score (PRS). Results: Among 1,095 G+ individuals (median age 46 years [IQR 34- 56]; 52.1% female), 808 (73.8%) were P+ at baseline, 56 (5.1%) developed HCM during follow-up, and 231 (21.1%) remained P-. AI-ECG achieved an AUROC of 0.91 (95% CI 0.89-0.93) for P+ at baseline and 0.92 (95% CI 0.90-0.94) for manifest HCM. At a threshold of 0.15, sensitivity was 0.78, specificity 0.89, PPV 0.95, and NPV 0.59. Among G+/P- individuals, higher AI-ECG scores predicted development of HCM (HR 1.55 per 1-SD; 95% CI 1.28- 1.88; p< 0.001; adjusted HR 1.38; 95% CI 1.11- 1.71; p=0.004). In the UK Biobank, individuals with both high AI-ECG and high PRS had 60-fold higher odds of HCM (adjusted OR 60.2; 95% CI 26.5- 137.2), versus 15.0 for high AI-ECG alone and 4.1 for high PRS alone. Conclusions: AI-ECG detects the HCM phenotype at baseline in sarcomere variant carriers, predicts development of HCM in G+/P- individuals, and complements PRS in the general population, supporting AI-ECG as a scalable tool to detect HCM and guide surveillance in individuals with monogenic or polygenic susceptibility.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：级联筛查越来越多地识别出携带致病性或可能致病性肌节变异的个体，这些个体有发生肥厚型心肌病（HCM）的风险，但外显率不完全，且监测依赖于资源密集型的连续影像学检查。我们评估了一个经过验证的人工智能增强心电图（AI-ECG）模型是否能在首次临床评估时识别HCM表型、预测随访期间HCM的发生，并补充多基因风险。方法：我们汇集了1,095名基因阳性（G+）个体，携带致病性或可能致病性肌节变异，来自Yale-New Haven Hospital（n=119）、Erasmus MC（n=858）和Motol University Hospital（n=118）。在基线（首次临床评估）时，个体被分类为表型阳性（P+）或表型阴性（P-）。一个先前验证过的AI-ECG模型应用于12导联心电图图像，生成HCM评分。主要结局是基线时表型阳性的检测；次要分析包括显性HCM（基线时或随访期间）以及识别G+/P-个体未来发生HCM的风险。在57,007名UK Biobank参与者中，我们评估了AI-ECG是否对已建立的多基因风险评分（PRS）有增量价值。结果：在1,095名G+个体中（中位年龄46岁[IQR 34-56]；52.1%女性），808名（73.8%）在基线时为P+，56名（5.1%）在随访期间发生HCM，231名（21.1%）保持P-。AI-ECG在基线P+方面的AUROC为0.91（95% CI 0.89-0.93），在显性HCM方面为0.92（95% CI 0.90-0.94）。在阈值0.15时，敏感性为0.78，特异性为0.89，PPV为0.95，NPV为0.59。在G+/P-个体中，较高的AI-ECG评分预测HCM的发生（每1-SD的HR为1.55；95% CI 1.28-1.88；p<0.001；校正后HR为1.38；95% CI 1.11-1.71；p=0.004）。在UK Biobank中，同时具有高AI-ECG和高PRS的个体发生HCM的比值比为60倍（校正后OR为60.2；95% CI 26.5-137.2），而单独高AI-ECG为15.0，单独高PRS为4.1。结论：AI-ECG在基线时检测肌节变异携带者的HCM表型，预测G+/P-个体HCM的发生，并在一般人群中补充PRS，支持AI-ECG作为一种可扩展的工具，用于检测HCM并指导具有单基因或多基因易感性个体的监测。

papers.title: GLP-1 Receptor Agonists, Stroke, and Cognitive Outcomes: Systematic Review and Meta-Regression
papers.translated_title: GLP-1受体激动剂、卒中与认知结局：系统综述与Meta回归
papers.author: Danielli, M.
papers.summary: Importance Randomised-controlled trials (RCTs) suggest glucagon-like-peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1RAs) reduce the risk of stroke in type 2 diabetes (T2DM); however, the mechanisms remain unclear. If benefits were driven principally by blood pressure (BP) lowering, similar effects on cognitive impairment may be expected. Evaluating data from trials with robust ascertainment and prespecified stroke and/or cognitive outcomes may provide greater clarity. Objective To confirm the effect of GLP-1RAs on stroke risk in RCTs with prespecified, adjudicated stroke endpoints; to explore whether risk reduction is associated with trial-level changes in systolic BP (SBP), glycated haemoglobin (HbA1c), or body weight; to establish whether a parallel cognitive signal exists. Data Sources PubMed, Cochrane, Embase, and CINAHL, from inception to August 2026 (PROSPERO CRD420261305938). Study Selection RCTs comparing GLP-1RAs with placebo/usual care in adults, with ?12 months follow-up, and prespecified stroke and/or cognitive outcomes. Data Extraction and Synthesis Hazard ratios (HRs) for stroke were pooled using inverse-variance random-effect meta-analysis. Univariable meta-regression related logHR for stroke to trial-level between-group differences in SBP, HbA1c and weight, with permutation-based inference and leave-one-out sensitivity analyses. The pooled effect was benchmarked against that predicted from achieved SBP differences. Heterogeneous cognitive outcomes were synthesized narratively. Main Outcomes and Measures Adjudicated stroke events and prespecified cognitive endpoints. Results Among 7 RCTs (n=50,617), GLP-1RA therapy was associated with 17% lower stroke risk (pooled HR 0.83; [95% CI 0.75-0.92]; p<.001). Meta regression showed an association with SBP (? = 0.371; [95% CI 0.013-0.729]; p=.043), but not HbA1c (0.432; [-0.064-0.928]; p=.088) or weight (0.109; [-0.038-0.256]; p=.148). The mean between-group SBP difference (~1.45 mmHg) predicts a stroke reduction of roughly 4%, versus the 17% observed, leaving approximately three quarters of the log-effect unexplained by BP lowering. Four trials (n=4,206) in established neurodegenerative disease showed no cognitive benefit. Conclusions and Relevance GLP-1RA therapy reduces stroke risk by 17% among individuals with T2DM at high cardiovascular risk, a benefit not fully accounted for by conventional cardiometabolic risk factor change. Additional mechanisms warrant evaluation. The absence of cognitive signal suggests the benefit may have cerebrovascular origin, but whether GLP-1RAs prevent vascular cognitive impairment in cardiometabolic populations remains untested.
papers.translated_summary: 重要性 随机对照试验（RCT）提示胰高血糖素样肽-1受体激动剂（GLP-1RA）可降低2型糖尿病（T2DM）患者的卒中风险；然而其机制仍不明确。若获益主要由降压驱动，则预期对认知障碍也会产生类似效应。评估具有稳健事件确认及预设卒中或认知结局的试验数据，可能提供更清晰的认识。目的 在具有预设、经裁定的卒中终点的RCT中，确认GLP-1RA对卒中风险的影响；探讨风险降低是否与试验层面的收缩压（SBP）、糖化血红蛋白（HbA1c）或体重变化相关；确定是否存在平行的认知信号。数据来源 PubMed、Cochrane、Embase和CINAHL，自建库至2026年8月（PROSPERO CRD420261305938）。研究选择 在成人中比较GLP-1RA与安慰剂或常规治疗的RCT，随访时间不少于12个月，并具有预设的卒中或认知结局。数据提取与综合 采用逆方差随机效应荟萃分析汇总卒中的风险比（HR）。单变量荟萃回归将卒中的对数HR与试验层面SBP、HbA1c和体重的组间差异相关联，并采用基于置换的推断和留一法敏感性分析。将汇总效应与根据实现的SBP差异所预测的效应进行基准比较。对异质性认知结局进行叙述性综合。主要结局与指标 经裁定的卒中事件和预设的认知终点。结果 在7项RCT（n=50,617）中，GLP-1RA治疗与卒中风险降低17%相关（汇总HR 0.83；[95% CI 0.75-0.92]；p<.001）。荟萃回归显示与SBP存在关联（？=0.371；[95% CI 0.013-0.729]；p=.043），但与HbA1c（0.432；[-0.064-0.928]；p=.088）或体重（0.109；[-0.038-0.256]；p=.148）无关。组间SBP平均差异（约1.45 mmHg）预测卒中降低约4%，而观察到的降低为17%，因此约四分之三的对数效应无法由降压解释。在已确诊神经退行性疾病中进行的4项试验（n=4,206）未显示认知获益。结论与意义 在高心血管风险的T2DM患者中，GLP-1RA治疗使卒中风险降低17%，这一获益不能完全由传统心血管代谢危险因素变化解释。其他机制值得评估。认知信号的缺失提示该获益可能源于脑血管机制，但GLP-1RA能否在心血管代谢人群中预防血管性认知障碍仍未得到验证。

papers.title: Imprints of chronic pain trajectories on brain volume and tissue properties
papers.translated_title: 慢性疼痛轨迹对脑容量和组织特性的印记
papers.author: Dirupo, G.
papers.summary: Despite advances in understanding the mechanistic underpinnings of chronic pain (CP) conditions, knowledge on the brain anatomy microstructure associated to CP trajectories is still scarce. We sought to fill this knowledge gap by combining longitudinal self-reported CP assessments with brain imaging in a community dwelling adult population (n = 976). Aiming to provide anatomical insights beyond morphometry (based on T1 brain images), we analyzed the derived relaxometry measures MTsat, R1 and R2* and we could investigate myelin and iron content. Participants were divided in three groups according to persistent, resolved or new CP and were compared to those without CP at timepoint. Participants with persistent CP exhibited lower grey matter (GM) in fronto-temporal cortical regions and reduced myelin-related signal in subcortical and thalamic areas, alongside higher iron-sensitive metrics in the entorhinal cortex. Those who recovered from CP showed reduced cortical GM and myelin encompassing subcortical nuclei, thalamus, frontal, parietal, and temporal regions. New-onset CP participants displayed reduced GM in cortical areas. Overall, we observed reduced GM volume in a widespread network of fronto-temporal cortical areas in participants with current, resolved and new-onset CP. Myelin-related metrics were lower in the subcortical nuclei and thalamus in participants with persistent and -to a greater extent- with resolved CP, whilst persistent CP was associated with higher iron-sensitive metrics in the entorhinal cortex. Hence, CP trajectories appear to leave differential imprints on brain morphometry and tissue microstructure, with each trajectory associated with distinct non-overlapping spatial and temporal patterns in GM, myelin, and iron content.
papers.translated_summary: 尽管在理解慢性疼痛（CP）机制的病理生理基础方面取得了进展，但关于与CP轨迹相关的大脑解剖微结构的知识仍然匮乏。我们通过将纵向自我报告的CP评估与社区居住成年人群（n = 976）的脑成像相结合，试图填补这一知识空白。为了提供超越形态测量学（基于T1脑图像）的解剖学见解，我们分析了衍生的弛豫测量指标MTsat、R1和R2*，从而能够研究髓鞘和铁含量。参与者根据持续性、已缓解或新发CP分为三组，并与时间点上无CP的参与者进行比较。持续性CP参与者表现出额颞叶皮层区域灰质（GM）较低，皮层下和丘脑区域髓鞘相关信号减少，同时内嗅皮层铁敏感指标较高。从CP中恢复的参与者表现出皮层GM和髓鞘减少，涵盖皮层下核团、丘脑、额叶、顶叶和颞叶区域。新发CP参与者表现出皮层区域GM减少。总体而言，我们在当前患有CP、已缓解CP和新发CP的参与者中观察到额颞叶皮层区域广泛网络中的GM体积减少。在持续性和——程度更甚地——已缓解CP的参与者中，皮层下核团和丘脑的髓鞘相关指标较低，而持续性CP与内嗅皮层较高的铁敏感指标相关。因此，CP轨迹似乎在大脑形态测量学和组织微结构上留下了不同的印记，每种轨迹在GM、髓鞘和铁含量方面与不同的非重叠空间和时间模式相关。

papers.title: Repeated SARS-CoV-2 Introductions with Limited Local Establishment in Bangladesh, 2020-2025
papers.translated_title: 2020至2025年孟加拉国SARS-CoV-2反复输入但本地传播有限
papers.author: Khair, S.
papers.summary: Genomic surveillance has shown how SARS-CoV-2 lineage composition emerges in densely sequenced, high-income settings. Whether reconstruction is possible where sequencing is sparse and intermittent, as in most low- and middle-income countries like Bangladesh, remains untested. To address this, genomes were collected in Bangladesh between March 2020 and July 2025 against a globally distributed background to infer a time-calibrated phylogeny and delineate Bangladeshi transmission lineages. Source attribution was tested against two independent null models that hold background sampling constant. Substitutions enriched in Bangladeshi genomes, relative to a comparator matched on lineage and collection month, were classified as imported or locally arising according to whether they were present at the root of their host lineage. Lineage introduction events were inferred at 361, of which 51.8% left a single sampled genome with no detected onward transmission. India and the Gulf were jointly dominant as source regions, exceeding a rarefied null model by 10.8 and 8.1 percentage points, while East Asia, South-East Asia and Rest-of-World fell significantly below it. Eighteen enriched substitutions, clustered by shared carriers into eleven independent signals, generated 171 substitution-lineage occurrences, of which 53 arose after their host lineage had entered Bangladesh. Spike G446V arose locally in 17 of 19 host lineages and reached 267 of 291 genomes (91.8%) of an imported Delta lineage, indicating that a locally arising substitution could achieve clade expansion. Whether import dependence declined over time could not be evaluated, as the statistic is confounded with sequencing effort. Importation determined which lineages circulated in Bangladesh, while local evolution determined what happened within them. Local substitutions transmitted readily but rarely reached lineage-wide frequency because their host lineages remained under genomic observation for only a short interval.
papers.translated_summary: 基因组监测已展示出SARS-CoV-2谱系构成如何在测序密集的高收入环境中形成。在测序稀疏且间歇的地区，如孟加拉国等大多数低中等收入国家，是否可能进行重建仍未经检验。为解决这一问题，研究收集了2020年3月至2025年7月期间孟加拉国的基因组，并以全球分布背景为参照，推断时间校准的系统发育树并划定孟加拉国传播谱系。来源归因通过两个独立的零模型进行检验，这两个模型保持背景采样恒定。相对于按谱系和采集月份匹配的比较组，在孟加拉国基因组中富集的替换，根据其是否存在于宿主谱系的根部，被分类为输入性或本地产生。共推断出361次谱系引入事件，其中51.8%仅留下一个采样基因组且未检测到后续传播。印度和海湾地区共同作为来源区域占主导地位，分别超过稀疏化零模型10.8和8.1个百分点，而东亚、东南亚和世界其他地区则显著低于该模型。18个富集替换通过共享携带者聚类为11个独立信号，产生了171次替换-谱系发生，其中53次发生在宿主谱系进入孟加拉国之后。Spike G446V在19个宿主谱系中的17个本地产生，并达到一个输入性Delta谱系291个基因组中的267个（91.8%），表明本地产生的替换可实现分支扩张。输入依赖性是否随时间下降无法评估，因为该统计量与测序努力相混淆。输入决定了哪些谱系在孟加拉国流行，而本地进化决定了这些谱系内部发生了什么。本地替换易于传播，但很少达到谱系范围的频率，因为其宿主谱系处于基因组观察之下的时间间隔很短。

papers.title: Estimation of stratified seroprevalence directly from raw serological assay measurements with multi-level Bayesian mixture modelling
papers.translated_title: 直接利用原始血清学检测测量值通过多水平贝叶斯混合模型估计分层血清阳性率
papers.author: Wymant, C.
papers.summary: Estimating seroprevalence for an infection -- the proportion of individuals with antibodies -- and its variability between subpopulations is a key first step for research and the allocation of resources for treatment and prevention. The relevant raw data is often serological assay measurements that serve as a proxy for antibody level, such as optical density values from enzyme-linked immunosorbent assays (ELISA). Analysis pipelines typically proceed through sequential steps of fitting calibration data independently in each separate batch, transforming assay measurements to antibody levels via each fitted calibration relationship, classifying antibody levels into discrete serostatus by comparison to a threshold, and finally comparing seropositive proportions between subpopulations. Such approaches have numerous limitations including loss of information, overconfidence (discarding uncertainty), and inappropriate choice of threshold. We developed a Bayesian statistical model that replaces the sequential steps of the typical pipeline by multiple levels within a single hierarchical model, treating each sample's antibody level as a model parameter rather than directly observed data. This integrates the connections from the raw assay measurements all the way through to subpopulation variability in seroprevalence, allowing partial pooling of information between related variables and the propagation of uncertainty from each part of the model throughout the whole of the rest of the model. We calculate observation probabilities for all assay measurements from both samples and calibration data, allowing easy identification of outlying calibration or sample measurements. We replace a single hard classification threshold for disease status by continuous probabilities that are adapted to each subpopulation. We allow a flexible multivariate random-effects logistic regression to capture variability in seroprevalence between subpopulations. Using simulated data we found that the typical stepwise approach gave prevalence estimates far from the true values with narrow confidence intervals. Our method, dvsb, had markedly greater accuracy. We report the run time and convergence of dvsb when applied to a real dataset for Lassa fever IgG antibodies measured with ELISA, comprising 72,863 measurements for 21,391 unique samples (results reported elsewhere). dvsb is available at https://github.com/BDI-pathogens/dvsb.
papers.translated_summary: 估计感染的血清流行率——即具有抗体个体的比例——及其在亚群间的变异性，是研究和分配治疗与预防资源的关键第一步。相关原始数据通常是作为抗体水平代理的血清学检测测量值，例如酶联免疫吸附试验（ELISA）的光密度值。分析流程通常按顺序进行：在每个独立批次中分别拟合校准数据，通过每个拟合的校准关系将检测测量值转换为抗体水平，将抗体水平与阈值比较以分类为离散的血清状态，最后比较亚群间的血清阳性比例。这类方法有许多局限性，包括信息损失、过度自信（丢弃不确定性）以及阈值选择不当。我们开发了一个贝叶斯统计模型，通过单一层次模型中的多个层级来替代典型流程的顺序步骤，将每个样本的抗体水平视为模型参数而非直接观测数据。这将从原始检测测量值一直到血清流行率的亚群变异性的联系整合起来，允许相关变量之间的部分信息合并，以及模型中每个部分的不确定性传播到模型其余所有部分。我们计算来自样本和校准数据的所有检测测量值的观测概率，从而易于识别异常的校准或样本测量值。我们用适应于每个亚群的连续概率替代疾病状态的单一硬分类阈值。我们允许使用灵活的多变量随机效应逻辑回归来捕捉亚群间血清流行率的变异性。使用模拟数据，我们发现典型的逐步方法给出的流行率估计值远离真实值且置信区间狭窄。我们的方法 dvsb 具有显著更高的准确性。我们报告了 dvsb 应用于一个真实数据集时的运行时间和收敛情况，该数据集为用 ELISA 测量的拉沙热 IgG 抗体，包含 21,391 个唯一样本的 72,863 次测量（结果在别处报告）。dvsb 可在 https://github.com/BDI-pathogens/dvsb 获取。
